subject: Escalation: ACME private deployment — EU data residency + audit rights + commercial concession
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Jensen <emily.jensen@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-05T09:15:00Z
Subject: Private deployment proposal + next steps

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I attached the latest DPA and a high-level quote for a private (VPC) deployment across EU data centers. High-level items: 

- 3-node dedicated cluster in EU region (replicated across two DCs)
- 12-month commitment, enterprise support, 99.9% SLA target
- Unit pricing as quoted in attached PDF; we costed for reserved capacity

Two asks from your side I noted: EU data residency (all inference and logs stay in EU) and formal audit rights for Acme (we expect a standard process for SOC / on-site verification). Before we lock in the commercials, can you confirm the exact audit scope and any procurement constraints?

I'm looping in our legal and finance partners in case you want to escalate approvals for any non-standard terms.

Next steps: please share procurement contacts and any internal policy docs (e.g., data residency checklist). I'll follow up with an updated quote including your residency/audit requests.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Jensen <emily.jensen@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-06-05T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deployment proposal + next steps

Rishi,

Thanks — quick clarifications from Acme:

- Data residency: must remain physically in EU; production inference + logs + backups must be in our Frankfurt and Amsterdam DCs.
- Audit: Acme requires the right to perform an annual assurance review (either review of SOC 2 reports or a limited on-site audit) that includes access to system logs and personnel interviews.
- Deployment constraint: On-prem installer preferred for air-gapped staging; production can be VPC but must not leave EU.

Procurement will want the final SLA and a clause around indemnity for data breaches. They may ask for a 24/7 support response SLA for critical incidents.

We are moving quickly on this — procurement contact here is procurements@acmehealth.com.

Emily Jensen
Head of Integrations, Acme Health

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-05T15:20:00Z
Subject: Fwd: ACME needs — request for exec approval (discount + audit/on-prem)

Folks — forwarding Acme's asks. Key escalation points that require an exec decision: 

1) Commercial concession: customer has asked for 25% off list to meet internal budget constraints (they're a strategic healthcare account). Sales recommends approval for up to 25% but with a 12-month committed ARR and 50% upfront payment.
2) Non-standard terms: 
   - EU-only data residency covering inference logs/backups + optional on-prem staging
   - Customer audit rights: annual assurance review with access to logs and personnel interviews; legal suggests limited scope wording
   - Indemnity / SLA: procurement will push for stronger indemnity and a 24/7 critical incident SLA

Attachments: ACME_Redline_Summary.docx (docx)

Requesting: Markus, can you confirm whether finance can approve a 25% concession conditional on 50% upfront + 12-mo commit, or whether we should cap at 20%? Monica, please advise on the audit wording we can accept without opening unlimited access. Laura/Aditya — I'll need an updated quote if finance approves.

Thanks,
Rishi

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-06T09:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: ACME needs — request for exec approval (discount + audit/on-prem)

Team — quick legal read and recommended language: 

- Data residency: we can commit that all customer data (inference inputs/outputs, logs, backups) will be stored and processed in EU-only regions for the production environment. For on-prem/staging, we will treat it as a customer-managed environment — Redwood will not transfer or retain customer data outside the provided environment.

- Audit rights: instead of an open-ended audit right, propose: "Acme may request one (1) annual assurance review, which may consist of (a) review of Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report covering the relevant services, or (b) a single on-site limited-scope audit limited to configuration and access controls relevant to Acme's environment, conducted during business hours with thirty (30) days prior notice. Any on-site audit will be scoped in advance and may not require production disruption; sensitive data export will be limited and subject to mutual agreement."

- Indemnity/SLA: propose to keep existing indemnity and add a critical-incident response commitment (1 hour P0 response, remediation timeline TBD) to satisfy procurement; any material change to indemnity needs senior exec sign-off.

Attachment: ACME_Redline_Summary.docx (highlights + redline)

This preserves reasonable customer assurance while limiting operational exposure. If finance is okay with a concession, we can proceed with Markus's approval language.

—Monica
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-07T10:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: ACME needs — request for exec approval (discount + audit/on-prem)

Rishi / team — after reviewing the ask and Monica's recommended language, I approve the following commercial and contractual concessions subject to the listed conditions: 

Approved concessions:
- Discount: Approve 20% off list pricing (not the full 25%) provided: (a) Acme signs a 12-month committed ARR, and (b) 50% of the first-year fees are paid upfront at signature.

- Audit: Approve Monica's proposed audit language (annual assurance review with SOC 2 Type II or a single limited-scope on-site audit with 30 days' notice). On-site audits must be strictly scoped; any requests to access production logs beyond agreed extracts require written approval from Security Ops.

- Data residency: Approve EU-only production residency as described. On-prem staging ok as customer-managed environment; Redwood will provide deployment guidance but not retain any data outside customer's environment.

Conditions (must be in contract):
1) Acme must provide proof of SOC 2 Type II within 30 days of signature or agree in writing to accept Redwood's SOC 2 Type II scope for the services.
2) Add an explicit statement limiting audit frequency to once per 12 months and limiting scope to controls relevant to Acme's environment.
3) Add indemnity carve-outs for customer-requested on-site activities that require additional engineering time; Redwood may invoice separately for extraordinary support.

If the customer insists on a deeper indemnity or unlimited audit rights, escalate back to me. For now, proceed with the 20% concession and the contract language Monica drafted. Laura/Aditya — update the quote and include the payment term (50% upfront).

Markus Klein
CFO, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Jensen <emily.jensen@acmehealth.com>, procurements@acmehealth.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-08T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deployment proposal + next steps — updated offer and approval

Emily / procurement team — thanks for the clarity and patience. Short summary of the agreement and next steps: 

1) Commercial: Redwood is prepared to proceed with a 20% discount on the quoted list price. Offer contingent on a 12-month commitment and 50% of first-year fees due at signature. Updated quote attached.

2) Data residency & deployment: Production inference, logs, and backups will reside in EU-only regions (Frankfurt/Amsterdam). On-prem staging is supported as a customer-managed deployment; Redwood will not transfer staging data out of the customer environment.

3) Audit: We accept an annual assurance review. Per agreed contract language, Acme may either (a) review Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report covering the services, or (b) conduct one (1) limited-scope on-site audit per 12-month period with 30 days' notice. On-site audits will be scoped in advance and any requests for full production log exports will require Security Ops sign-off.

4) Next steps: I have attached the updated quote (Quote_ACME_Private_20260608.pdf) and the DPA. If this aligns, I'll send the contract for signature via DocuSign (link below). Please confirm and let me know if procurement needs any additional paperwork.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/ACME/Envelope/12345
Attachments: Quote_ACME_Private_20260608.pdf, Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting ACME onboarded.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
